title: Knowledge Library
ragDescription: Knowledge Libraries enable you to leverage both global libraries and create customized document collections for enhanced interactions with Elsa. These libraries serve as curated knowledge bases that allow you to receive more accurate, contextually relevant responses tailored to your specific regulatory needs. With flexible document management, you can add or remove documents based on your permission level, ensuring your library remains current and relevant to your work. Additionally, you can share customized libraries with colleagues while keeping sensitive departmental information protected and accessible only to authorized users. This functionality transforms Elsa from a general AI assistant into a specialized tool that understands the unique context and requirements of your regulatory work.
